# Topic Intent Layer — arc-aware continuation + pre-send arc check

## Problem

On a multi-turn investigation topic (especially Telegram), the resuming
session receives the last N messages as continuation context. That is a
**transcript, not a brief**. There is no captured "stated goal of this
topic" at the top of context. When the user asks question N+1, the agent
answers it against the literal last 1–2 turns instead of against the
arc of the investigation.

Concrete failure (topic qalatra / 9235, 2026-05-14): user asked a
deep-dive whose stated goal was (1) what should Instar adopt from
qalatra, and (2) how would Instar + qalatra fit together. Every
follow-up (worker, MCP server, heartbeats, skills/agents, jobs need
agent.md) was a tile in that mosaic. The agent answered heartbeats and
skills/agents as standalone trivia, never grounded in the stated goal.
The user correctly diagnosed this as an infra/awareness gap, not a
discipline failure: the bootstrap can't inject what isn't stored.

## Solution

Three layers, built in order. Each layer has independent value; the
stack is what closes the loop structurally.

### Layer 1 — TopicIntent record (storage + extractor)

Per-topic semantic state stored alongside existing topic state:

```
{
  topicId: number,
  statedGoal: string,        // 2–3 sentence synthesis
  openThreads: string[],     // unanswered probes against the goal
  established: string[],     // settled facts / decisions
  extractedAtTurn: number,
  lastUpdatedAt: ISO8601,
  model: string,             // which model wrote this (Haiku 4.5 default)
  costTokens: number,        // cumulative for cost ceiling
}
```

Extraction trigger: on the **second substantive user turn** of a topic
(skip turn 1 so the goal isn't mistaken for the opener). A cheap
Haiku-class call reads the early turns and emits stated goal +
open-threads. Re-extracted when a scope-change classifier (also Haiku)
flags a user turn as "redefines or expands scope."

Storage location: new file `.instar/topic-intent/<topicId>.json`
(parallel to existing `.instar/topic-resume-map.json`). Out of band of
DB so it survives sqlite ABI drift and is plain-text inspectable.

### Layer 2 — Arc-aware continuation header

The Telegram bootstrap script
(`src/templates/hooks/telegram-topic-context.sh` and adjacent ctx
builders) prepends a new section to the bootstrap ctx file **above**
the message history:

```
=== TOPIC INTENT ===
STATED GOAL: <statedGoal>

OPEN THREADS:
- <thread 1>
- <thread 2>

ESTABLISHED:
- <fact 1>
- <fact 2>

=== RECENT MESSAGES (last 50) ===
[…existing transcript…]
```

If no TopicIntent record exists (first-turn topics, opted-out topics,
short threads), the header is omitted — backwards compatible, no
behavior change.

### Layer 3 — Pre-send arc check

Outgoing messages on intent-tracked topics run through a cheap
classifier before relay. The classifier compares the draft against the
TopicIntent record and returns one of:

- `advances-goal` — the draft moves at least one open thread forward
  or explicitly ties new info to the stated goal. → Send as-is.
- `narrow-but-acknowledged` — the draft answers a sub-question but
  explicitly notes how it ties back to the goal. → Send as-is.
- `literal-only` — the draft answers only the literal last user
  message with no grounding in the arc. → Block; return guidance to
  the session to re-draft with grounding, OR annotate the draft with
  "narrow answer to sub-question; here's how it ties back."

Signal-vs-authority compliant: classifier emits a signal; the agent
session is the higher-context decision-maker. The classifier never
mutates the message body.

## Components

**New files:**
- `src/core/TopicIntent.ts` — extractor (Haiku call), store
  (read/write JSON), scope-change classifier.
- `src/core/ArcCheck.ts` — pre-send classifier (Haiku call), returns
  one of the three states above.

**Modified files:**
- `src/templates/hooks/telegram-topic-context.sh` — inject intent
  header above message history when record exists.
- `src/messaging/TelegramAdapter.ts` — call ArcCheck on outbound to
  intent-tracked topics; route literal-only verdict back to the
  session via the existing tone-gate failure path.
- `src/server/routes.ts` — read endpoint for inspection / dashboard;
  write endpoint for manual override.
- `InstarConfig` — `topicIntentLayer.enabled` (default true for new
  agents, opt-in for existing).

## Decision-point inventory (for convergence)

These are the design questions the convergence review should pressure-test:

1. **Trigger turn for extraction.** Default: second substantive user
   turn. Alternative: every Nth turn (smoother but more cost).
2. **Scope-change detection.** Default: cheap classifier per user
   turn. Alternative: explicit user signal only (`/refocus`). Risk:
   classifier false positives cause goal flip-flop.
3. **Authority of arc check.** Default: blocking on literal-only.
   Alternative: signal-only (annotate but don't block). The user has
   precedent ([[feedback-signal-vs-authority]]) that brittle filters
   should not have authority — but this classifier is LLM-backed with
   full draft + intent context, so blocking is justified.
4. **Cost ceiling.** Default: per-topic monthly token budget for
   intent extraction + arc checks. Cap at ~$0.10/topic/month at Haiku
   prices. Spec must define what happens at ceiling — degrade to
   signal-only? Disable? Pause and alert?
5. **Inter-topic leak.** TopicIntent is per-topic-per-agent; no
   cross-agent or cross-topic read. Confirm storage path enforces
   this.
6. **First-turn protection.** Skip extraction on opening message so
   "I need a Fathom transcript" isn't recorded as the goal when the
   real goal emerges in turn 3. Confirm turn-counting logic survives
   relay/edit/retry.
7. **Non-Telegram channels.** v1 scope = Telegram only. Slack and
   iMessage go in v2 unless arc check is trivially portable.
8. **Latency budget.** Arc check runs synchronously before send. Must
   add < 1.5s p95 to perceived response time. [[feedback-gate-latency-vs-client-timeout]]
   — gate has to be timeout-aware and fail-open on classifier
   timeout, NOT fail-closed (don't drop messages over arc check).

## Tests (acceptance)

- **Unit / TopicIntent extractor**: stable goal across two
  paraphrases of the same opening 2 turns (cosine similarity > 0.85
  on goal text, identical open-thread set after normalization).
- **Unit / ArcCheck**: golden table — for each (intent, draft) pair,
  classifier returns expected verdict. Include the qalatra incident
  as a test fixture (intent = adopt+integrate qalatra into instar;
  draft = bare heartbeats answer; expected verdict = literal-only).
- **Integration / bootstrap**: starting a fresh session on an
  intent-tracked topic produces a ctx file with TOPIC INTENT header
  above the transcript; without a record, header omitted.
- **Integration / outbound**: a draft reply that ignores stated goal
  is intercepted; a draft that ties back is sent unchanged.
- **Regression**: short topics (<= 2 turns total) never trigger
  extraction; one-off Telegram messages still relay normally.
- **Failure mode**: ArcCheck classifier timeout / API error →
  fail-open, message sent unmodified, telemetry incremented.

## Side-effects review (initial — full review at convergence)

- **Over-block**: arc check might block legitimate narrow answers
  (user actually wants a yes/no). Mitigation: classifier prompt
  includes "if the user explicitly asked for a narrow answer, that
  IS advancing the goal."
- **Under-block**: classifier may miss subtle drift. Mitigation:
  telemetry on classifier confidence; periodic offline replay of
  conversations to tune.
- **Cost**: per-topic Haiku calls add up. Mitigation: budget ceiling
  (decision point #4); skip arc check on trivially short drafts
  (< 200 chars) where grounding is rarely possible.
- **Latency**: see decision point #8.
- **Rollback**: feature flag flip → all three layers no-op, ctx files
  revert to transcript-only, outbound bypasses arc check. No data
  migration. Existing TopicIntent JSON files orphan harmlessly.
- **Privacy**: TopicIntent records summarize conversation content;
  same trust boundary as topic message history. No new
  external-data path.

## Rollout / rollback

- **Rollout:** gated behind `topicIntentLayer.enabled` config flag.
  Default `true` for new agents; existing agents get a one-time
  prompt-of-the-user to opt in (per the existing tone-gate adoption
  pattern). Soak on echo agent for 7 days before broader rollout.
- **Rollback:** flip flag to `false`. All three layers no-op. Stored
  TopicIntent JSON files are read-only after rollback and ignored.

## Out of scope (v1)

- Cross-channel (Slack, iMessage, WhatsApp).
- Cross-topic / project-level intent (intent spanning multiple
  topics).
- Auto-suggested topic rename based on extracted intent.
- Retroactive backfill of TopicIntent for existing topics (manual
  trigger only via `/refocus` until v2).
- Dashboard UI for browsing/editing intent records (read endpoint
  ships; rich UI deferred).

## Future (v2 candidates)

- Project-level intent record that subsumes multiple related topics.
- "This conversation has drifted from its stated goal — refocus or
  update intent?" nudge after N consecutive `narrow-but-acknowledged`
  verdicts in a row.
- Non-Telegram channel ports.
- Retrospective backfill across the topic archive.

## Origin

Topic 9235 (qalatra), 2026-05-14. Justin's diagnostic was the failure
mode that justifies layers 1–3 in this order. The qalatra incident is
preserved as the canonical arc-check test fixture.
